methods.name: public int getIndexOfEarlierOrEqualSynchronizationSample(long timeUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns the sample index of the closest synchronization sample at or before the given
   * timestamp, if one is available.
   *
   * @param timeUs Timestamp adjacent to which to find a synchronization sample.
   * @return Index of the synchronization sample, or {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if none.

methods.name: public int getIndexOfLaterOrEqualSynchronizationSample(long timeUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns the sample index of the closest synchronization sample at or after the given timestamp,
   * if one is available.
   *
   * @param timeUs Timestamp adjacent to which to find a synchronization sample.
   * @return index Index of the synchronization sample, or {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if none.
